A '''small consortium of corporate interests''' was the only trading partner of the [[Zakuulan government|elected government]] of the newly independent [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zakuul]], according to [[Alliance Intelligence Summary 495-22]], a report authored by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Lana Beniko]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]]. It was Beniko's personal suspicion that the consortium was actually a front for the criminal organization known as the [[Exchange]], but investigations by [[Alliance Intelligence (Eternal Alliance)|Alliance Intelligence's]] [[Agent/Legends|agents]] were still ongoing.<ref name="TOR" />
